sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Paramedic is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Young man, I have a task that suits your area of expertise. A friend of mine, a paramedic still early in his career, recently told me a disturbing story. Just before the catastrophe, he was transporting patients with unexplained symptoms, almost as if there had been an outbreak of a new disease. At the hospitals, unfamiliar individuals would take them away and transfer them to private wards. The young man managed to photograph their observation logs while they were collecting another patient. However, in the midst of the catastrophe, he dropped his smartphone containing all the data. He says they were on their way to pick up another patient near the Concordia residential complex. For everyone's sake, please find this phone for me. The paramedic will be waiting for you under the protection of my people, inside an SUV on Primorsky Avenue, and he will confirm its authenticity. I sincerely hope I can count on you, young man."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the ambulance paramedic's smartphone on Streets of Tarkov
- Extract from Streets of Tarkov through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex
- Hand over the smartphone

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Yes, I've heard the report, this is what we've been looking for. My men will begin retrieving the information immediately. And you, young man, are free to go. Thank you for your help."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Paramedic's GPhone X | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |

In this quest you have to find the ambulance paramedic's smartphone on Streets of Tarkov and extract with it through the "Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex" extraction while it is in your in-raid quest inventory. The taxi extraction with the phone does not need to be done in the same raid that you found the phone. The phone can be located at one of eight ambulances across the location.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance south of the cardinal apartment complex, under the "President restaurant" signs.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance at Klimova street 18, near the "Basement Descent" Scav extraction.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On the ground behind the ambulance south of the Pinewood hotel.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: On the passenger seat of the ambulance at Chekannaya street 15, opposite the Sparja store.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance at Primorsky avenue, opposite the LexOs car dealership.

sections.heading: Sixth spawn
sections.text: On the ground at the right side of the ambulance on the playground of the Concordia apartment complex.

sections.heading: Seventh spawn
sections.text: On the ground just outside the passenger door of the ambulance at the "Crash Site" extraction. Note: The phone is located in the extraction zone.

sections.heading: Eighth spawn
sections.text: In the back of the ambulance at the loading area, to the south of Razvedchikov street.
